lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 20 — Through Macedonia and Greece / Eutychus / Farewell at Miletus

questions.questionText: When the uproar ended Paul sent for the disciples and after encouraging them said goodbye and set out for where?
He traveled through that area then arrived in Greece, where he stayed how long?
Because some Jews made a plot against him as he was about to sail for Syria, he decided to go back through where?
I am from Berea and I went with him. Who am I?
Aristarchus and I are from Thessalonica. Who am I?
I am Gaius from Derbe. Who traveled with me from that area?
Tychicus and I are from the province of Asia. Who am I?
These men went on ahead and waited for us at where?
We sailed from Philippi after the Festival of Unleavened Bread and five days later joined the others at Troas, where we stayed how long?
On the first day of the week we came together to break bread. Paul spoke until when?
I was seated in a window, sank into a deep sleep, and fell from the third story. Who am I?
Eutychus was picked up dead. What did Paul do?
options: He threw himself on the young man and put his arms around him
He left at once without helping

questions.questionText: Paul said, Don’t be alarmed. He’s what?
Then Paul went upstairs again and broke bread and ate. He talked until when?
True or false: The people took the young man home alive and were greatly comforted.
options: True — but Paul never spoke again

questions.questionText: We went on ahead to the ship and sailed for Assos, where we were going to take Paul aboard. He went there how?
options: By swimming the whole way named

questions.questionText: After Assos they went to Mitylene, Chios, Samos and then to where?
Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus to avoid spending time in the province of Asia. He was in a hurry to reach Jerusalem by when?
From Miletus, Paul sent to Ephesus for whom?
Paul said, You know how I lived the whole time I was with you. I served the Lord with what?
Paul said he has not hesitated to preach anything that would be helpful. He taught publicly and from where?
Paul declared to both Jews and Greeks that they must turn to God in repentance and have faith in whom?
Paul said he is going to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen, except that in every city the Holy Spirit warns him of what?
I consider my life worth nothing to me; my only aim is to finish the race and complete the task of testifying to the good news of God’s _____.
Paul said none of you among whom I have gone about preaching the kingdom will ever see what?
I am innocent of the blood of any of you. For I have not hesitated to proclaim to you the whole _____ of God.
Paul told the elders to keep watch over themselves and all the flock. The Holy Spirit has made them what?
Paul said savage wolves will come in among you and will not spare the flock. Even from your own number men will arise and do what?
options: Distort the truth in order to draw away disciples after them

questions.questionText: Paul said remember that for how long I never stopped warning each of you night and day with tears?
Paul committed them to God and to the word of his grace, which can build them up and give them an inheritance. He never coveted what?
options: Anyone’s silver or gold or clothing

questions.questionText: Paul said these hands of mine have supplied my own needs and the needs of my companions. What words of the Lord Jesus did he recall?
options: It is more blessed to give than to receive
It is more blessed to get gold

questions.questionText: When Paul had finished, he knelt down with all of them and prayed. What did they do?
options: They wept as they embraced him and kissed him

questions.questionText: What grieved them most?
options: His statement that they would never see his face again

questions.questionText: Then they accompanied him to the what?
True or false: There were many lamps in the upstairs room at Troas.
options: False — it was dark with no lamps

questions.questionText: Paul was eager to reach Jerusalem by Pentecost so he sailed past which city?
I fell from the third story during Paul’s long talk. Who am I?
True or false: Paul helped Eutychus and said he is alive.
options: True — but they were not comforted

questions.questionText: Who bought Paul by the blood of his own Son, the church of God?
options: God (the flock he bought with his own blood)

questions.questionText: The farewell speech to the elders happened at where?
